script_text: Taurus, the ground beneath your feet is shifting — and you need to pay attention. This month, your ruling planet Venus is transiting through your 11th House of friendships and long-term goals, forming a powerful trine with Jupiter in your 3rd House. This is the cosmic green light you have been waiting for. In love, Venus energizes your social circle — a deep connection could spark through a group event or mutual friend, especially if you are single. For career and money, Saturn in your 10th House of reputation squares your natal Sun, demanding discipline — a major professional decision requires patience, but the payoff is real. Mars in your 6th House keeps your energy steady, so maintain your routine. Watch June 9th for a financial opportunity, June 17th for a romantic breakthrough, and June 24th for a career crossroads. Avoid overcommitting to others' agendas this month. Stay grounded, Taurus — your element is Earth, and it will hold you steady.
